labels.title: Amministrazione · Fatture
labels.description: Incoming invoices for SRL, LTD or Branch, credit notes (nota di credito), payment receipts, failed-payment and overdue notices from software vendors and suppliers, proformas with amounts. Not collaborator invoices or event-venue invoices.

labels.title: Amministrazione · Richieste
labels.description: Administrative requests that need an answer: company data requests, grants and tenders, legal matters with lawyers or courts, document requests from the external accountant (commercialista).

labels.title: Amministrazione · Documenti
labels.description: Company documentation: insurance policies, contracts, certificates.

labels.title: Accounting
labels.description: Accounting and tax content from external accountants (commercialisti): VAT register, F24, monthly closing, balance sheet. A request for documents from the accountant is admin.requests.

labels.title: Clienti
labels.description: Existing customers (signed contract or active paid service) writing about their work with us: requests, answers, renewals, decks. Prospects and demos are business.dev; suppliers are never clients.

labels.title: Personale · Collaboratori
labels.description: Invoices and messages from external collaborators: individual freelancers working for us, not companies.

labels.title: Ops · Spaces
labels.description: Building and space requests about our offices and event spaces.

labels.title: Eventi · Interni
labels.description: Our own events and events we take part in: trade fairs, conferences, offsites, logistics, until the event has ended.

labels.title: Eventi · Esterni
labels.description: External companies asking to host a real event in our spaces.

labels.title: Eventi · Post
labels.description: Only after an event has ended: thanks, feedback, invoices of the venue.

labels.title: Tech · Avvisi
labels.description: Automatic technical notifications: monitoring, deploys, SaaS service and security alerts, and automated reports or system emails from our own platform.

labels.title: Marketing · News
labels.description: Newsletters, promotions, partner and press communications.

labels.title: Business · Sviluppo
labels.description: Prospects, demos, partnerships, resellers and agencies, investors: commercial contacts before a contract.

labels.title: Notifiche
labels.description: Delivery and PEC receipts, bounces, automatic replies, booking, calendar and ticketing system notices, login links. Payment receipts and failed payments are admin.invoices.

labels.title: Personale (privato)
labels.description: Private mail on personal mailboxes: bank, family. Never shown in the digest.

labels.title: Da classificare
labels.description: Anything the classifier is not confident about.
